{{Quote|A hyperspace sinkhole is all that remains of the Waymancy bridal seat, and on a thousand Rim worlds the flag of the Republic flies high.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''Waymancy bridal seat''' was an object<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Waymancy system/Legends|Waymancy system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> as well as the region known as the [[Waymancy Hollow]], inside which the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]] studied and improved upon [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology for a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] leading up to [[7811 BBY]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the organization known as the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] fought the Republic in a conflict known as the [[Waymancy Storm]]. By the conclusion of the war, in which the Republic emerged victorious, the Waymancy bridal seat had been reduced to a [[hyperspace sinkhole]]. At a speech delivered on the [[25th anniversary of Victory in the Waymancy Storm]] in [[7786 BBY]], the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Nagratha]] mentioned the destroyed object in a brief recount of the history of the conflict.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Waymancy bridal seat was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the object, authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Waymancy bridal seat was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
